description: This Java class models the <debug-xa-resources> XML element in the OFBiz entity configuration, providing a boolean flag based on the 'value' attribute.

classes.name: DebugXaResources
classes.description: A thread-safe, final class that represents the <debug-xa-resources> XML element with a boolean indicating if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: DebugXaResources
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DebugXaResources object by parsing the 'value' attribute from an XML element.
